svg.title: Webmention, Brid.gy and webmention.io flow

desc.style: fill:rgb(0, 0, 0);stroke:none;color:rgb(11, 11, 11);stroke-width:1px;stroke-linecap:butt;stroke-linejoin:miter;opacity:1;font-family:anthropic-sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:400;text-anchor:start;dominant-baseline:auto

svg.desc: Your post is published to Mastodon and Bluesky through Brid.gy. Replies and likes on those posts return through Brid.gy as webmentions, are stored by webmention.io, and are fetched by your site to render comments.
